pre_acquisition.command: tools/fan-control.sh status && A='mlxfast-'; B='runtime-worker'; C='benchmark.sh --local-'; if pgrep -x mlxfast-swift >/dev/null || pgrep -f "$A$B" >/dev/null || pgrep -x swift-frontend >/dev/null || pgrep -x swift-driver >/dev/null || pgrep -f "$C" >/dev/null; then echo 'competing_processes=true'; exit 1; else echo 'competing_processes=false'; fi && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && echo 'worktree_clean=true' && git diff --exit-code 922de16b035e037686dec820eee7426d1311b4e7 HEAD -- Sources/MLXFastHarness/LagunaRuntimeWorker.swift Sources/MLXFastModel/LagunaRuntimeModel.swift Sources/MLXFastTrustedHarness/LagunaRuntimeLocalIterate.swift Sources/MLXFastTrustedHarness/LagunaRuntimeWorker.swift Vendor/mlx-swift/Source/MLX/EvalProbe.swift Vendor/mlx-swift/Source/MLX/MLXArray.swift Vendor/mlx-swift/Source/MLX/MLXFastKernel.swift Vendor/mlx-swift/Source/MLX/Transforms+Eval.swift research/run_host_census.sh && echo 'all_9_frozen_blobs_exact=true'

markers: mlxfast: benchmark elapsed=15.0s local thermal gate start phase=host-census
benchmark.sh: strict persistent macmon confirmed phase=host-census samples=5 interval=1000ms final=39.3C
benchmark.sh: GPU cool-down gate passed (current 39.3C, target <=40C, waited 20s)
mlxfast: benchmark elapsed=45.6s local thermal gate complete phase=host-census

post_acquisition.command: date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'; tools/fan-control.sh status; ps -p 53627 -o pid=,ppid=,comm=,args=; pgrep -x mlxfast-runtime-worker; pgrep -x mlxfast-swift; pgrep -x swift-frontend; pgrep -x swift-driver; pgrep -x metal; git status --short --untracked-files=all

continuous_during_acquisition.reason: No independent continuous fan-mode trace was persisted during the acquisition.
